title: Activation Settings by Program Type — Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
Each program type of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs has its own activation settings: whether an enrollment must be activated before it can be used, how many calendar days from enrollment activation may take, whether the first paid program claim itself activates it, and who enrolls the patient.

| Program type | Must be activated before use | Activation window (calendar days from enrollment) | First paid program claim activates the enrollment | Who enrolls the patient |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Rx Discount Card | No | 0 | No | Enrolled by Kestrel |
| Kestrel Rx Savings Club Individual | Yes | 30 | No | Enrolled by Kestrel |
| Kestrel Rx Savings Club Family | Yes | 30 | No | Enrolled by Kestrel |
| Manufacturer Copay Card | Yes | 30 | Yes | Manufacturer hub |
| Manufacturer Bridge Program | Yes | 14 | Yes | Manufacturer hub |
| Charitable Foundation Copay Grant | Yes | 30 | No | Foundation application |

## Settings explained

- **Must be activated before use** — Yes means the enrollment must be activated before it is used; the Kestrel Rx Discount Card is the one program type marked No.
- **Activation window** — the calendar days from enrollment within which activation must happen. A setting of 0 appears only where activation is not required.
- **First paid program claim activates** — Yes for the Manufacturer Copay Card and the Manufacturer Bridge Program.
- **Who enrolls the patient** — *Enrolled by Kestrel* means Kestrel enrolls the patient itself; *Manufacturer hub* means the enrollment is obtained from the drug manufacturer's hub; *Foundation application* means the enrollment is obtained by application to the foundation.

## Side-by-side reading (from the table)

| Program type | Window | Activated by first claim |
|---|---|---|
| Manufacturer Bridge Program | 14 days, the shortest window | Yes |
| Manufacturer Copay Card | 30 days | Yes |
| Kestrel Rx Savings Club Individual and Family | 30 days | No |
| Charitable Foundation Copay Grant | 30 days | No |
| Kestrel Rx Discount Card | none (0; activation not required) | No |
